name: assets_count_order
description: REQ-816 / GH #4375 (asset count K1, D-128). The header of a fixed asset count order: one org unit, the kinds to count (json list of fixed, low_value, intangible, stored in that order), the planned period, the chair, a status and the issued document. status is draft, ordered, counting, counted, sheet_signed, signed or cancelled (all seven are declared now: widening an enum later is a class B upgrade). org_unit_id is the scope column. Master references (org unit, employee, location) are record ids checked in code (0076 R6), not foreign keys. K2 (REQ-817) added the optional fields cut_off_at, cutoff_seq, opened_by (open), sheet_document_id, sheet_number, closed_at, closed_by (close) and sheet_signed_at, sheet_signed_by (sheet marks); later slices K3 to K5 add more optional fields (class A, optional_field_added). K5 (REQ-820) added the freeze fields: freeze_started_at, freeze_until, freeze_whole_unit, freeze_location_ids (set at open of a freeze order).
